name: Configurable split-rail (Vcc/Vss) generator for multi-source SiC gate levels
function: Creates positive and negative gate rails around the source from a single isolated output with a resistor-Zener network (optionally with an upstream linear regulator) so that one PCB supports different SiC V_GS requirements by BOM change.

inputs.name: V_total
inputs.description: single isolated DC/DC output (fixed or adjustable)

operating_conditions: Configurations +15/-5 ... +20/-5 V and unipolar +15/0 or +18/0 V published by Wolfspeed.

required_components.value_or_part: sets V_total for regulation of all outputs

design_calculations.name: Zener dissipation
design_calculations.expression: P_Z = V_Z * (I_bias - I_load,neg) at minimum load

interface_requirements: DC/DC must operate over the needed output range when adjustable (PRD-04814 example 3).
pcb_constraints: Split network placed at the driver supply pins; rail capacitors close to driver.
validation_notes: Configuration tables are manufacturer examples without load or tolerance analysis; AIPE did not simulate them.
limitations: Zener split regulation degrades with load changes; light-load Zener current and heavy-load droop must be checked.
